bounded_slice: Pin exact released unknown-task, update and cancel semantics plus one official ServerHandler implementation, then tighten the application-owned persistent adapter trio to exact released identifiers with authorization before store access.
findings: TaskManager::get_task, update_task and cancel_task all call the same unknown_task(task_id) helper after the TTL sweep. unknown_task returns McpError::invalid_params(format!("unknown task: {task_id}"), None).

TaskManager::update_task returns Result<(), McpError>; it ignores unknown/already-answered/superseded input-response keys by only removing keys still present in pending_inputs, touches the task, recomputes current status, and returns Ok(()).

TaskManager::cancel_task returns Result<(), McpError>; it records cancel_requested=true and signals the cooperative cancellation watch. For a nonterminal task it clears pending input senders, touches the task, and reports current status. The acknowledgement is immediate; terminal cancelled/failed/completed status is decided later by the running operation.

The official TaskDemo ServerHandler uses GetTaskParams -> Result<GetTaskResult, McpError> with GetTaskResult::new(self.tasks.get_task(&request.task_id)?), UpdateTaskParams -> Result<(), McpError>, and CancelTaskParams -> Result<(), McpError>. This fixes the released handler result shapes for a custom persistent implementation.

TaskDemo advertises ServerCapabilities::builder().enable_tools().enable_tasks().build(). Its task path still uses stock in-memory TaskManager; the example is wire/handler-shape evidence, not restart-durability evidence.

design: get_task(request: GetTaskParams, context: RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<GetTaskResult, McpError>: first derive a server-authenticated principal from trusted RequestContext transport metadata and run the current tasks/get authorization check; only then read the application-owned persistent store; map absent task to McpError::invalid_params(format!("unknown task: {}", request.task_id), None); return GetTaskResult::new(detailed_task).

update_task(request: UpdateTaskParams, context: RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>: authenticate and re-authorize current tasks/update policy before persistent-store access; require ownership/intent binding for request.task_id; atomically consume only still-pending input-response keys and ignore already-consumed keys, matching stock TaskManager semantics; map absent task to the same invalid_params unknown-task error.

cancel_task(request: CancelTaskParams, context: RequestContext<RoleServer>) -> Result<(), McpError>: authenticate and re-authorize current tasks/cancel policy before persistent-store access; atomically record cancellation intent and signal/mark the claimed attempt without pretending cancellation is terminal; return Ok(()) on acknowledgement and let the fenced executor commit the eventual completed/cancelled/failed terminal state.
All store, claim-generation, restart-redrive and effect-fencing helpers remain application-owned abstractions. No stock rmcp identifier is asserted for those missing primitives.
